title: Coalesce streaming proxy chunks and introduce route weighting to stabilize OpenAI-compat traffic
author: Maya Tan
description: Motivation: customer reports and internal canaries showed frequent small fragmented stream frames and noisy route selection changes under bursty traffic when OpenAI-compat mode is enabled. Small fragments increase CPU and connection churn for downstream clients and inflate billing token counts for short responses. Additionally, the router was oscillating between equivalent backends when experimental cost-based routing was active, causing intermittent tail-latency regressions. This PR introduces two coordinated changes: 1) a configurable coalescing window in the streaming proxy that aggregates small chunks into larger frames before forwarding (preserves order and streaming semantics, defaults to conservative 8ms/1KB thresholds), and 2) route weighting pins for compatible model variants so the router respects a sticky weight for short-lived requests to reduce flapping. Changes include lightweight metrics, a targeted rollout plan, and backwards-compatible feature flags. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked - https://linear.redwood.ai/ENG-5312 - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Feature flag and migration plan - [x] Docs and compatibility note Added tests exercise fn-call and structured output across the coalescing boundary. Rollout plan: enable feature flag for 10% traffic on dedicated, monitor 95/99 latencies and 'stream_frame_reassembly' metric for 48h, then widen to 50% before global release. Backwards compatibility: feature flag off maintains previous behavior; coalescing is bounded and disables for flagged routes that require strict per-token flushing (realtime voice, websocket low-latency flows). Monitoring/alerts: new alert 'gateway.coalesce.backpressure' when proxy queue depth exceeds threshold and 'router.weighting.flap' when route selection changes >20% within 5m. Impact: reduces small-frame counts, lowers connection churn, and stabilizes tail latency for OpenAI-compat routes. See release_notes for short summary.

merge_commit_message:
squash: proxy coalesce + route weighting: reduce small-frame noise and router flapping

Coalescer default: 8ms/1KB; per-route override available. Route weights pinned to reduce selection churn for short requests. Includes metrics, tests, and docs.
